title: Twixy Mod
description: This project adds a cat named Twixy, a Scottish fold cat, also it's not a normal cat it better than normal cat.
body:
Twixy Mod
---------------------------

Welcome to Twixy Mod!

This mod adds Twixy, a unique cat companion that is much more than an ordinary Minecraft cat. Twixy isn't a horror creature or a cosmetic pet—it's a loyal companion designed to help you survive your adventures.

Unlike normal cats, Twixy can assist you in combat, making it a valuable friend when exploring dangerous areas and fighting hostile mobs. Twixy is intentionally rare to find, so you'll need a bit of patience, but the reward is well worth the search.

If you're looking for a pet that's both fun and genuinely useful, Twixy is the perfect companion.

Credits: The original concept was inspired by a project I found inside find a project.

---

Required Dependencies
---------------------------

Before installing this mod, make sure you have:

- Fabric API (matching your Minecraft version)
